risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantified operating, acquisition, cash, and segment information, but relies on forward-looking assurances and hedging around tariffs, inflation, construction weakness, and geopolitical uncertainty. Use of non-GAAP measures and exclusion of special items may make underlying performance and restructuring impacts less transparent. Liquidity appears adequate, although Europe weakness, cost inflation, potential tariffs, and acquisition-related execution remain material risks.
